title: Vibhishana's installation
introduction: Matali, Indra's charioteer leaves the battle-field and returns to his heaven. Then, Rama instructs Lakshmana to arrange for the installation of Vibhishana on the throne of Lanka. Lakshmana arranges to get sea-water from some monkey-chiefs and sprinkles it on vibhishana, to instal him as the King of Lanka, in the presence of the demons there. Then, Rama sends his message to Seetha through Hanuma.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्वादशाधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 112th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ते रावणवधं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वदानवाः |
जग्मुः स्वैः स्वै र्विमानैस्ते कथयन्तः शुभाः कथाः
verses.iast:
te rāvaṇavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvadānavāḥ |
jagmuḥ svaiḥ svai rvimānaiste kathayantaḥ śubhāḥ kathāḥ
verses.translation: Having seen the destruction of Ravana, those gods, celestial musicians and demons, while chatting about the auspicious narrative, went away in their respective aerial cars.

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य वधं घोरं राघवस्य पराक्रमम् |
सुयुद्धं वानराणां च सुग्रीवस्य च मन्त्रितम्
अनुरागं च वीर्यं च सौमित्रे र्लक्ष्मणस्य च |
पतिव्रतात्वम् सीताया हनूमति पराक्रमम्
कथयन्तो महाभागा जग्मुर्हृष्ट यथागतम् |
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya vadhaṃ ghoraṃ rāghavasya parākramam |
suyuddhaṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca sugrīvasya ca mantritam
anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitre rlakṣmaṇasya ca |
pativratātvam sītāyā hanūmati parākramam
kathayanto mahābhāgā jagmurhṛṣṭa yathāgatam |
verses.translation: Chatting themselves about the awful destruction of Ravana, the terrific prowess of Rama, the admirable combat of the monkeys, the counsel tendered by Sugreeva, the affection and valour of Lakshmana; the son of Sumitra; the loyaltyof Seetha to her husband and about the strength of Hanuma, the illustrious celestials and others rejoicingly returned as they had come.

glosses.meaning: the admirable combat of the monkeys
the loyalty of Seetha to her husband

verses.devanagari:
राघवस्तु रथं दिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तं शिखिप्रभम्
अनुज्ञाय महाबाहुर्मातलिं प्रत्यपूजयत् |
verses.iast:
rāghavastu rathaṃ divyamindradattaṃ śikhiprabham
anujJṇāya mahābāhurmātaliṃ pratyapūjayat |
verses.translation: Taking leave of the celestial chariot, which had been given by Indra the lord of celestials and which shone like fire, the mighty armed Rama respectfully saluted Matali.

glosses.meaning: which had been given by Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातो मातलिः शक्रसारथिः
दिव्यं तं तथमास्थाय दिवमेवोत्पपात ह |
verses.iast:
rāghaveṇābhyanujJṇāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ
divyaṃ taṃ tathamāsthāya divamevotpapāta ha |
verses.translation: As assented by Rama, Matali Indra's charioteer, mounting that celestial chariot, ascended to the heaven itself.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिंस्तु दिवमारुढे सरथे रथिनां वरः
राघवः परमप्रीतः सुग्रीवं परिषस्वजे |
verses.iast:
tasmiṃstu divamāruḍhe sarathe rathināṃ varaḥ
rāghavaḥ paramaprītaḥ sugrīvaṃ pariṣasvaje |
verses.translation: When Matali ascended to heaven along with his chariot, Rama, the foremost one among the chariot-warriors was highly rejoiced and embraced Sugreeva.

verses.devanagari:
पर्ष्वज्य च सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणेनाभिवादितः
पूज्यमानो हरिगणैराजगाम बलालयम् |
verses.iast:
parṣvajya ca sugrīvaṃ lakṣmaṇenābhivāditaḥ
pūjyamāno harigaṇairājagāma balālayam |
verses.translation: Having embraced Sugreeva greeted by Lakshmana and having been honoured by the monkey-troops. Rama came to the camp where the army had been stationed.

glosses.meaning: to the camp where the army had been stationed.

verses.devanagari:
अथोवाच स काकुत्स्थः समीपपरिवर्तिनम्
सौमित्रिं सत्त्वसंपन्नं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् |
verses.iast:
athovāca sa kākutsthaḥ samīpaparivartinam
saumitriṃ sattvasampannaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
verses.translation: Then, Rama spoke (as follows) to Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, who was endowed with strength and having auspicious marks, who stayed nearby.

glosses.meaning: endowed as he was with strength

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणमिमं सौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय
अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च तथा पूर्वोपकारिणम् |
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇamimaṃ saumya laṇ^kāyāmabhiṣecaya
anuraktaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca tathā pūrvopakāriṇam |
verses.translation: "O the benevolent Lakshmana! Consecrate on the throne of Lanka, this Vibhishana to whom everyone is attached, a loyal person as he is and the one who has formerly done a service to us."

glosses.meaning: the one who has formerly done a service to us.

verses.devanagari:
एष मे परमः कामो यदिमं रावणानुजम्
लङ्कायां सौम्य पश्येयमभिषिक्तं विभीषणम् |
verses.iast:
eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo yadimaṃ rāvaṇānujam
laṇ^kāyāṃ saumya paśyeyamabhiṣiktaṃ vibhīṣaṇam |
verses.translation: "O gentle one! This s my paramount desire that I should see this Vibhishana, the brother of Ravana being consecrated for throne in Lanka."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राघवेण महात्मना
तथेत्युक्त्वा सुसंहृष्टः सौवर्णम् घटमाददे |
verses.iast:
evamuktastu saumitrī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
tathetyuktvā susaṃhṛṣṭaḥ sauvarṇam ghaṭamādade |
verses.translation: Hearing the words of the great soled Rama, Lakshmana replied, 'so it be' and rejoicingly procured a golden pot.

verses.devanagari:
तं घटं वानरेन्द्राणाम् हस्ते दत्त्वा मनोजवान्
व्यादिदेश महासत्त्वः समुद्रसलिलं तदा |
verses.iast:
taṃ ghaṭaṃ vānarendrāṇām haste dattvā manojavān
vyādideśa mahāsattvaḥ samudrasalilaṃ tadā |
verses.translation: That mighty Lakshmana, then placing that pot in the hands of the monkey-chiefs, instructed them, who were as swift as thought, to bring sea-water.

verses.devanagari:
अतिशीघ्रम् ततो गत्वा वानरास्ते मनोजवाः
आगतास्तु जलं गृह्य समुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः |
verses.iast:
atiśīghram tato gatvā vānarāste manojavāḥ
āgatāstu jalaṃ gṛhya samudrādvānarottamāḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, those excellent monkeys, with the swiftness of thought, moving very quickly from that place, returned, having obtained the water from the sea.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्त्वेकं घटं गृह्य संस्थाप्य परमासने
घटेन तेन सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् |
लङ्कायां रक्षसां मध्ये राजानं रामशासनात्
विधिना मन्त्रदृष्टेन सुहृद्गणसमावृतः |
verses.iast:
tatastvekaṃ ghaṭaṃ gṛhya saṃsthāpya paramāsane
ghaṭena tena saumitrirabhyaṣiJṇcadvibhīṣaṇam |
laṇ^kāyāṃ rakṣasāṃ madhye rājānaṃ rāmaśāsanāt
vidhinā mantradṛṣṭena suhṛdgaṇasamāvṛtaḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, Lakshmana together with his friends, taking one pot and making Vibhishana to sit on the throne, sprinkled him with sea-water from that pot in accordance with the rule prescribed in Vedic scriptures, while the demons were witnessing the ceremony, to make him the king for Lanka, as directed by Rama.

glosses.meaning: in accordance with the rule (in Vedic scriptures)
in the middle of the demons

verses.devanagari:
अभ्यषिञ्चंस्तदा सर्वे राक्षसा वानरास्तथा
प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा तुष्टुवू राममेव ह |
verses.iast:
abhyaṣiJṇcaṃstadā sarve rākṣasā vānarāstathā
praharṣamatulaṃ gatvā tuṣṭuvū rāmameva ha |
verses.translation: Then, all the demons as well as the monkeys consecrated Vibhishana. Having gained extra ordinary delight, they indeed eulogized Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यामात्या जहृषिरे भक्ता ये चास्य राक्षसाः
दृष्ट्वाभिष्क्तं लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम् |
verses.iast:
tasyāmātyā jahṛṣire bhaktā ye cāsya rākṣasāḥ
dṛṣṭvābhiṣktaṃ laṇ^kāyāṃ rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam |
verses.translation: Seeing Vibhishana the lord of demons consecrated for the throne of Lanka, his four counsellors who were always together with him and such of those demons who were devoted to him, were rejoiced.

verses.devanagari:
राघवः प्रमां प्रीतिं जगाम सहलक्ष्मणः
स तद्राज्यं महत्प्राप्य रामदत्तं विभीषणः |
verses.iast:
rāghavaḥ pramāṃ prītiṃ jagāma sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
sa tadrājyaṃ mahatprāpya rāmadattaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Rama together with Lakshmana were greatly delighted. That Vibhishana, having gained that great kingdom bestowed on him by Rama, was also greatly delighted.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृतीः सान्त्ययित्वा च ततो राममुपागमत्
दध्यक्षतान् मोदकांश्च लाजाः सुमनसस्तथा |
आजह्रुरथ संतुष्टाः पौरास्तस्मै निशाचराः
verses.iast:
prakṛtīḥ sāntyayitvā ca tato rāmamupāgamat
dadhyakṣatān modakāṃśca lājāḥ sumanasastathā |
ājahruratha santuṣṭāḥ paurāstasmai niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: After consoling his people, Vibhishana then sought to presence of Rama. Now, the demons who were residing in the city were quite delighted and brought to him (by way of presents) curds, unbroken grains of rice, sweets shaped like balls, parched grains of unhusked rice and flowers too.

glosses.meaning: who were residing in the city

verses.devanagari:
स तान् गृहीत्वा दुर्धर्षो राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
माङ्गल्यं मङ्गलं सर्वं लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् |
verses.iast:
sa tān gṛhītvā durdharṣo rāghavāya nyavedayat
māṇ^galyaṃ maṇ^galaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān |
verses.translation: Accepting them, the valiant and unconquerable Vibhishana happily offered all those auspicious objects to Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
कृतकार्यं समृद्धार्थं दृष्ट्वा रामो विभीषणम्
प्रतिजग्राह तत्सर्वं तस्यैव प्रियकाम्यया |
verses.iast:
kṛtakāryaṃ samṛddhārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmo vibhīṣaṇam
pratijagrāha tatsarvaṃ tasyaiva priyakāmyayā |
verses.translation: Seeing Vibhishana, who had accomplished his act and increased his resources, Rama accepted it all, with a sole desire to show gratefulness to him.

glosses.meaning: with a sole desire to show gracefulness to him.

verses.devanagari:
ततह् शैलोपमं वीरं प्राञ्जलिं प्रणतं स्थितम्
उवाचेदं वचो रामो हनूमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् |
verses.iast:
tatah śailopamaṃ vīraṃ prāJṇjaliṃ praṇataṃ sthitam
uvācedaṃ vaco rāmo hanūmantaṃ plavaṇ^gamam |
verses.translation: Thereupon, Rama spoke the following words to the valiant Hanuma the monkey who was equal in size to a mountain and who was standing in humility, with his hands joined in salutation.

glosses.meaning: who was equal in size to a mountain
with his palms joined together for salutation.

verses.devanagari:
अनुज्ज़्नाप्य महाराजमिमं सौम्य विभीषणम्
प्रविश्य नगरीं लङ्कां कौशलं ब्रूहिमैथिलीम् |
verses.iast:
anujJnāpya mahārājamimaṃ saumya vibhīṣaṇam
praviśya nagarīṃ laṇ^kāṃ kauśalaṃ brūhimaithilīm |
verses.translation: "O the benevolent one! Taking permission from this Vibhishana, the great king and entering into the City of Lanka, inform about our welfare to Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
वैदेह्यै मां कुशलिनं सुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम्
अचक्ष्व वदतां श्रेष्ठ रावणं च हतं रणे |
verses.iast:
vaidehyai māṃ kuśalinaṃ sugrīvaṃ ca salakṣmaṇam
acakṣva vadatāṃ śreṣṭha rāvaṇaṃ ca hataṃ raṇe |
verses.translation: "O Hanuma, the proficient one in speech! Inform Seetha that myself together with Lakshmana and Sugreeva are well and that Ravana had been killed in battle."

verses.devanagari:
प्रियमेतदुदाहृत्य वैदेह्यस्त्वं हरीश्वर
प्रतिगृह्य च संदेशमुपावर्तितुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
priyametadudāhṛtya vaidehyastvaṃ harīśvara
pratigṛhya ca sandeśamupāvartitumarhasi |
verses.translation: "O Hanuma the master of monkeys! Making clear this favourite news to Seetha, you ought to return, taking back her message."
